Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Ratnesh Chandra Hon'ble Rajan Roy,J.

Heard.

By means of present petition, petitioners seeks the following relief:-
"A writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus commanding the opposite parties particularly to opposite party no. 3 to pay 15 percent statutory interest per annum as per the provisions of section 34 of Land Acquisition Act 1894 to the Salik Ram And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. / ... on 8 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119565993/
1 petitioner on awarded compensation from the date of compulsory award till actual date of payment of compensation i.e. 21-10-2008 to 25-10-2023."
